title: How to Draw an Awesome Cityscape: Art Tutorial
description: A cityscape tutorial starts by bringing imagined nature into an office-bound city, tears through a fence, builds dense Hong Kong–New York–San Francisco–Los Angeles geometry, adds a nighttime doorway and ends by questioning how long a painting really took.
summary: A cityscape tutorial starts by bringing imagined nature into an office-bound city, tears through a fence, builds dense Hong Kong–New York–San Francisco–Los Angeles geometry, adds a nighttime doorway and ends by questioning how long a painting really took. This is an official-channel creative lesson or reflection, not clinical treatment or a universal formula. Its chronological map follows the route's own transcript and distinguishes art-making instructions from autobiographical claims, jokes and metaphors. Visually dependent technique still requires the source video.
